Title: User can access password reset flow from login page
Preconditions: User is on the login page and not logged in
Steps:
1. 1. Navigate to the login page
2. 2. Locate the 'Forgot password?' link
3. 3. Click the 'Forgot password?' link
Expected Result: User is redirected to the password reset request page with email input field

Title: Valid registered email receives reset link within 2 minutes
Preconditions: User has a registered account with email 'user@example.com'; user is on the password reset request page
Steps:
1. 1. Enter registered email 'user@example.com' in the email field
2. 2. Click 'Submit' or 'Send reset link' button
3. 3. Check email inbox for reset link email
4. 4. Verify email received within 2 minutes
Expected Result: Reset link email is received within 2 minutes; generic success message displayed on UI (e.g., 'If this email exists, a reset link has been sent')

Title: Unregistered email shows generic message without revealing account existence
Preconditions: Email 'nonexistent@example.com' is not registered in the system; user is on the password reset request page
Steps:
1. 1. Enter unregistered email 'nonexistent@example.com' in the email field
2. 2. Click 'Submit' or 'Send reset link' button
3. 3. Observe the UI message
Expected Result: Same generic message displayed as for registered email (e.g., 'If this email exists, a reset link has been sent'); no indication that email is not registered

Title: Reset link is valid for 30 minutes and allows password change
Preconditions: Reset link email received for registered user; link is less than 30 minutes old
Steps:
1. 1. Click the reset link from the email
2. 2. Verify redirect to password reset page with new password fields
3. 3. Enter valid new password meeting requirements (min 8 chars, 1 number, 1 special char): 'NewPass123!'
4. 4. Confirm new password: 'NewPass123!'
5. 5. Click 'Reset Password' or 'Submit' button
Expected Result: Password successfully reset; user redirected to login page or success page; confirmation email sent

Title: Reset link expires after 30 minutes
Preconditions: Reset link email received for registered user; link is more than 30 minutes old (simulate by manipulating timestamp or waiting)
Steps:
1. 1. Click the expired reset link from the email
2. 2. Observe the page shown
Expected Result: Error message displayed indicating link has expired (e.g., 'This reset link has expired. Please request a new one.'); user cannot set new password

Title: New password must be minimum 8 characters
Preconditions: User is on the password reset page via valid reset link
Steps:
1. 1. Enter password with 7 characters including number and special char: 'Pass1!'
2. 2. Confirm password: 'Pass1!'
3. 3. Click 'Reset Password' button
Expected Result: Validation error displayed: password must be at least 8 characters; password not reset

Title: New password must include at least 1 number
Preconditions: User is on the password reset page via valid reset link
Steps:
1. 1. Enter password with 8+ chars and special char but no number: 'Password!'
2. 2. Confirm password: 'Password!'
3. 3. Click 'Reset Password' button
Expected Result: Validation error displayed: password must include at least 1 number; password not reset

Title: New password must include at least 1 special character
Preconditions: User is on the password reset page via valid reset link
Steps:
1. 1. Enter password with 8+ chars and number but no special char: 'Password123'
2. 2. Confirm password: 'Password123'
3. 3. Click 'Reset Password' button
Expected Result: Validation error displayed: password must include at least 1 special character; password not reset

Title: Password confirmation must match new password
Preconditions: User is on the password reset page via valid reset link
Steps:
1. 1. Enter valid new password: 'NewPass123!'
2. 2. Enter non-matching confirmation: 'NewPass123@'
3. 3. Click 'Reset Password' button
Expected Result: Validation error displayed: passwords do not match; password not reset

Title: All existing sessions are logged out after successful password reset
Preconditions: User is logged in on two different devices/browsers (Device A and Device B); user has valid reset link
Steps:
1. 1. On Device A, use reset link to set new password: 'NewPass123!'
2. 2. Complete password reset successfully
3. 3. On Device B, attempt to access a protected page or refresh the session
Expected Result: Session on Device B is invalidated; user redirected to login page; must log in with new password

Title: Confirmation email sent after successful password change
Preconditions: User completes password reset successfully via valid reset link
Steps:
1. 1. Complete password reset with valid new password
2. 2. Check email inbox for confirmation email
Expected Result: Confirmation email received stating password was changed successfully; includes timestamp and possibly IP/device info

Title: Reset link cannot be reused after successful password reset
Preconditions: User has already successfully used a reset link to change password
Steps:
1. 1. Click the same reset link from the email again
2. 2. Attempt to submit a new password
Expected Result: Error message displayed: link already used or invalid (e.g., 'This reset link has already been used. Please request a new one.'); cannot reset password again with same link

Title: Rate limit: max 3 reset requests per email per hour
Preconditions: User has registered email 'user@example.com'; no reset requests made in the last hour
Steps:
1. 1. Request password reset for 'user@example.com' (1st request)
2. 2. Wait briefly, request again (2nd request)
3. 3. Wait briefly, request again (3rd request)
4. 4. Wait briefly, request again (4th request)
5. 5. Observe UI response for 4th request
Expected Result: First 3 requests succeed (generic success message); 4th request blocked with rate limit error (e.g., 'Too many requests. Please try again later.'); no additional emails sent for 4th request

Title: Rate limit resets after 1 hour
Preconditions: User has made 3 reset requests for 'user@example.com' in the last hour and is currently rate limited
Steps:
1. 1. Wait for 1 hour to pass since first request (or manipulate system time)
2. 2. Request password reset for 'user@example.com' again
Expected Result: Request succeeds (generic success message); reset link email sent; rate limit counter reset

Title: Empty email field shows validation error
Preconditions: User is on the password reset request page
Steps:
1. 1. Leave email field empty
2. 2. Click 'Submit' button
Expected Result: Validation error displayed: email is required

Title: Invalid email format shows validation error
Preconditions: User is on the password reset request page
Steps:
1. 1. Enter invalid email format: 'not-an-email'
2. 2. Click 'Submit' button
Expected Result: Validation error displayed: invalid email format
